answer_4.quote: We invited two Chinese native speakers to annotate randomly sampled 25% of claim-evidence pairs with SUPPORTED, REFUTED or NOT ENOUGH INFO. The results demonstrated strong agreement between humans and GPT-4.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to assign one of the labels SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or NOT ENOUGH INFO to each claim-evidence pair and to flag any non‑grammatical or typo issues.
